Maria S.: Quick async check 9 I hit a broken in-page anchor in the deploy runbook while updating the kv-cache snippet. Anchor URL: https://kb.internal/docs/deploy/kv-cache#troubleshooting previews the page but the fragment 404s in the doc viewer. Can someone pick this up? I can open a tiny PR unless owners want to do it.
link-scanner-bot: Scan result: document 'deploy/kv-cache.md' header changed; old anchor '#troubleshooting' no longer exists (header now 'Troubleshooting & FAQ') 9 suggests adding an explicit id to preserve legacy fragments.
Jon P.: I can take that if it's just adding an explicit id to the H2.
Sam K.: Is this causing runtime links to fail anywhere, or only onboarding/dev preview flows?
Maria S.: Only onboarding preview and a few internal notes, but several new hires hit it during the setup script. Not user-facing, just noisy.
Priya R.: FYI codeowners for /docs/deploy are @eng-docs and @onboarding-squad 9 small change will need an owners-approval in PR.
Maria S.: Proposed minimal change: add an explicit id so old fragments keep working. Example:
```md
## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}
```
That maintains canonical header text but restores the old fragment.
Jon P.: Sounds good. Simple sed/perl fix should work across the repo.
Maria S.: Ran a quick perl locally: `perl -0777 -pe "s/## Troubleshooting(?!\s*\{)/## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}/s" -i docs/deploy/kv-cache.md` 9 will open PR with that and a short changelog entry.
Sam K.: I'll volunteer to CR once PR is up. Ping me.
Jon P.: Also recommend searching for any other references: `rg "kv-cache#troubleshooting" -n .` so we update links or callouts in onboarding.
Maria S.: Good call 9 I'll attach rg output to the PR description.
Priya R.: When you open the PR, tag `@eng-docs` in the description; that usually speeds review for small docs fixes.
Maria S.: Opening PR in ~12m, will include the scan output and note for owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Jon P.: If you want a faster merge I can approve after Sam's CR.
Maria S.: Leaving Jon to shepherd merge, will add a tiny changelog line to the runbook. Appreciate the help :rocket:
